mara.activity: Wake, make the bed, drink water, and gather myself before getting dressed.
mara.intention: Start slowly enough that the deadline pressure does not take over the whole morning.

mara.activity: Wash up, brush my teeth, and change into work clothes.
mara.intention: Get ready efficiently for the studio and site visits.

mara.activity: Make coffee and eat a small breakfast at the kitchen island while checking the presentation sequence in my head.
mara.intention: Fuel up without getting pulled into messages too early.

mara.activity: Do a short strength workout and shower before heading to work.
mara.intention: Keep my body awake and discharge some of the nervous energy.

mara.activity: Return home, collect my laptop, project folder, planting sketches, fabric samples, and field notebook, then leave for the studio and site visits.
mara.intention: Have every presentation-critical item together and avoid a last-minute search.

mara.activity: Work at the studio on the major presentation, tightening the planting narrative and checking that each plan decision is defensible.
mara.intention: Resolve the substantive priorities before the day fills with meetings and site details.

mara.activity: Eat a quick lunch and step away from the presentation materials for a few minutes.
mara.intention: Keep enough distance to notice inconsistencies rather than staring them into existence.

mara.activity: Attend the client meeting and complete site visits, making only the final necessary presentation revisions afterward.
mara.intention: Present the work clearly while protecting the coherence of the overall design.

mara.activity: Take a brisk walk around the neighborhood before answering work messages.
mara.intention: Let the pressure settle before deciding what, if anything, needs a response tonight.

mara.activity: Come home, remove my work shoes, place my keys deliberately in the entryway, and set my field notebook on the living room sideboard.
mara.intention: Make a clean transition from work and put the things I will need next where I can find them.

mara.activity: Cook a simple tomato pasta for myself at the range, using the market herbs from the glass beside the sink, then eat at the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Make real food without turning dinner into another performance; Julian is working dinner service tonight.

mara.activity: Wash the skillet, plate, fork, and cooking tools, wipe the island, and move my keys from the entryway to the kitchen island.
mara.intention: Leave the kitchen settled enough that tomorrow does not begin in yesterday's clutter.

mara.activity: Do one bounded final review of the presentation checklist at the living room sideboard, then close the laptop and leave the project materials together.
mara.intention: Confirm the sequence without reopening every design decision.

mara.activity: Sit alone in the piano hall with the lights low and play a few slow scales.
mara.intention: Let the meeting and deadline noise taper off before the evening becomes too quiet.

mara.activity: Make tea, drink it in the living room, and read a few pages of my paperback book.
mara.intention: Shift from making judgments to simply following something at an easy pace.

mara.activity: Wash up, change into sleep clothes, brush my teeth, and put my work clothes ready for laundering.
mara.intention: Close the day without carrying the presentation back into bed.

mara.activity: Read a few more pages in bed with the lights low, keeping the phone aside.
mara.intention: Give my mind a gentler final focus than the presentation.

mara.activity: Put the paperback book and reading glasses on the top of my nightstand, set my phone aside, and go to sleep.
mara.intention: Leave the morning essentials in their usual places and let the day end.

julian.activity: Wake beside Mara, drink water, and lie still for a few minutes rather than checking work messages.
julian.intention: Start gently and keep the morning from becoming another demand.

julian.activity: Take a hot shower, brush my teeth, and dress in work trousers, a restaurant shirt, wool socks, and kitchen clogs.
julian.intention: Get warm and ready without rushing Mara's morning.

julian.activity: Grind coffee and make eggs with butter, toast, carrots, and fruit; carry a mug and plate to the dining table and eat quietly.
julian.intention: Have a steady breakfast before the long split shift.

julian.activity: Make a small tomato-and-carrot soup, ladle it into a bowl, cover it, and leave it on the kitchen island for Mara with a spoon beside it.
julian.intention: Leave her something warm and easy for the deadline day without interrupting her.

julian.activity: Clear my plate and mug to the sink, rinse them, pack my backpack with the tablet, restaurant notebook, menu folder, and thermos, then take the knife roll from the lower kitchen cabinet.
julian.intention: Gather everything in one pass so I do not have to improvise later.

julian.activity: Collect my backpack and knife roll, pick up my keys from the piano's middle shelf, and leave for the restaurant.
julian.intention: Leave on time for deliveries and prep.

julian.activity: Handle restaurant prep, receive deliveries, check produce and supplies, organize the kitchen, and work through the service list.
julian.intention: Keep the kitchen orderly before the Friday rush and catch problems early.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, return the knife roll to the lower kitchen-cabinet shelf, and put my backpack down by the island.
julian.intention: Unload the workday before resting, even if the backpack stays out for now.

julian.activity: Eat yogurt and a banana from the refrigerator, drink water, and sit in the living room without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Refuel and make the transition into the second shift quietly.

julian.activity: Lie down for a short quiet reset, then check that my phone and restaurant notebook are in my backpack.
julian.intention: Rest briefly without falling into a long nap or taking on new decisions.

julian.activity: Put on my jacket, pick up my backpack, and collect my keys from the piano shelf before leaving.
julian.intention: Get back out the door with the minimum necessary fuss.

julian.activity: Run dinner service, help the line through the Friday rush, finish closing duties, and keep the final kitchen checks precise rather than hurried.
julian.intention: Protect the team from avoidable mistakes and get the restaurant safely closed.

julian.activity: Travel home, bring the thermos into the kitchen and set it beside the sink, drop my wallet and earplugs on the living-room coffee table, and take a hot shower.
julian.intention: Follow the familiar post-service landing routine and let the noise drain away.

julian.activity: Eat a small portion of leftover pasta and yogurt from the refrigerator, then brush my teeth without turning on the television.
julian.intention: Give myself just enough food before bed, with no extra stimulation.

julian.activity: Change into sleep clothes, put my phone on its charger, and get into bed beside Mara.
julian.intention: End the long day in the shared bedroom and go straight to sleep.

julian.activity: Lie still and let the day go quiet.
julian.intention: Recover before the next service day.
